blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippines has led a dialogue with Cambodia and Timor Leste to discuss how other members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) could take steps in adopting an abolitionist approach to the death penalty in the region. Former president and incumbent Pampanga Rep. Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo on Friday facilitated the ministerial-level discussion at the Department of Justice (DOJ) central office in Manila with Justice Undersecretary Raul Velasquez representing the Philippines, as well as the respective justice ministers of Cambodia and Timor Leste.
